title: GSD X Mission Obligations
description: Holds shipping while a derived mission obligation is still open. The obligations, the contract projection and the closure receipt are owned by modules/gsd_x/mission; this manifest is only the registration that makes them reachable from a real GSD run.

notes.claude: The only runtime installed on the host this was proven against (.gsd-runtime = claude). Other runtimes are left unlisted rather than declared unsupported, because nothing here has been measured against them.
notes.shellRequirement: MEASURED 2026-09-23, and it is a hard prerequisite this manifest previously left undeclared. The gate below is a command-exit-zero predicate, which gsd-core runs through execTool('sh', ['-c', ...]) at check-command-router.cjs:1100. Where bare `sh` does not resolve, that call exits 127 and gate-predicate-evaluator.cjs:94-102 maps any non-zero exit to block:true -- so with blocking:true and onError:halt the gate halts EVERY ship, unconditionally, for a reason unrelated to obligations. On this Windows host sh.exe exists twice (Git for Windows bin/ and usr/bin/) and resolveExecutableBinary('sh') still returns null, so the prerequisite is RESOLUTION, not presence. Do not switch gsd_x_mission.enabled on until `sh` resolves inside the dispatch surface. Pinned by tools/test_gsd_x_sh_dispatch.js (4/4, both controls).

gsd_x_mission.enabled.description: Hold shipping while a derived mission obligation is still open. Off by default: capability install writes to the runtime config dir, so this gate is visible to every GSD project on the host, and it fails closed (onError: halt) once switched on.
